name: fixnow
description: FixNow competition MVP: customer + technician Android app, admin web dashboard, shared REST API.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/api install && npm --prefix apps/admin install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.admin:prod: npm --prefix apps/admin run build && npm --prefix apps/admin run start
scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && node flow.mjs && node flow2.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/api run typecheck && cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../admin && npx tsc --noEmit
